aggregate.truncation_rows_scope: budget-terminal rows only; the pre-expansion node guard stops a node without writing one, and is reported by nodes_stopped_by_the_node_guard and runs_truncated_by_the_node_guard

assumptions.clause: The candidate space at three items is declared by this rung, not by the seal. The sealed unpruned generator is declared to two items and refuses above it. Below three items the rung defers to the sealed generator and declares nothing, and no sealed pruning lemma is used at any item count.
assumptions.not_established: That the declared space is the space the seal would have declared.

assumptions.clause: The declared space is checked against an independently written wider construction at item counts zero, two and three on every base of the declared cross-check family, and against the sealed generator at zero, one and two.
assumptions.not_established: Anything about bases outside the declared family, which carries at most three data and at most one form while the rectangle reaches five data and three forms.

assumptions.clause: Every demanded pair is a target and no orbit is quotiented away. That is the sibling's shipped rule, which departs from the sibling's own written question; the departure is inherited deliberately and recorded.
assumptions.not_established: That the orbit rule and the shipped rule agree.

assumptions.clause: Two states merge only under the sibling's repaired key, which pairs its state key with the exact indexed regime and the commitment name. Presentation tokens stay forgotten, and the implemented relation is cross-checked against a minimum over all bijection pairs inside the sealed apparatus it calls.
assumptions.not_established: That the merge relation is the coarsest one a reader might want.

assumptions.clause: Two situations are one situation exactly when the indexed regime component of the sibling key, the commitment name, the demand kind and the demanded pair all agree. A refusal record counts a node, not a situation, and a refusal short-circuits its node.
assumptions.not_established: That situations distinct under this relation are distinct problems.

assumptions.clause: The inherited no-regress member governs the twenty runs of the rectangle, the twenty runs of the two-item reconstruction, both censuses and the re-derivation of the refusal population. The member this rung declares is run on the deduplicated three-item enumeration situations and on the deduplicated refusal situations, and nowhere else. Every row names the member that produced it.
assumptions.not_established: Any statement about the declared member at a state where it was not run.

assumptions.clause: The rectangle is both sealed genesis readings, the five named stakes of the sibling tree, both sealed cost measures, responses of at most three items with form arity at most two, at most fifteen accepted rounds and a pre-expansion node guard of two hundred and fifty. The growth data bound of five governs growth alone and does not bind a response; a run that passes it is recorded with the count it reaches.
assumptions.not_established: Anything at four items or at arity three.

assumptions.clause: Five budgets, each with its own terminal naming the tree, the node and the demanded pair: at most forty enumerations at three items in one run, at most one million candidates examined in one enumeration, at most two thousand valid responses gathered at one demanded pair, at most two hundred retained classes at one node, and the bijection budget the sibling raises inside its own key. A node whose gathering is cut short attaches nothing. The enumeration budget is per RUN and the class budget governs retention at a node, so both govern the tree loop alone; the candidate and response budgets govern one enumeration at one demanded pair and are enforced in the tree loop AND in the situation gatherer, which is not a run. An earlier version enforced none of the five in the gatherer while presenting its zero as measured; the observed maxima are recorded beside the bounds.
assumptions.not_established: That a budget which did not fire here could not fire at a wider bound.

assumptions.clause: A repeated enumeration is answered from the record of the one before it whenever the indexed state, the commitment, the demanded pair and the validity member agree exactly: within one run for the tree loop, and across the situation tables for the gatherer. It is a cache and never a lemma, and both hit counts are recorded.
assumptions.not_established: That two situations with different tags differ in answer.

assumptions.clause: The wall bound of the run is a declared terminal. When it does not fire the receipt carries no reading of a clock and no environment value; when it fires the receipt says so, names where, and is not byte-reproducible. It is deliberately larger than any caller's time budget and protects no such budget: it exists so that a run which stops early stops NAMED, and a caller who wants a smaller ceiling passes one on the command line and accepts a receipt that is not byte-reproducible.
assumptions.not_established: That the bound is generous enough at a wider rectangle, or that a run finishing inside it finishes inside any other time budget.

assumptions.clause: The committed sibling summary receipt is read as the pinned two-item record. It is replayed by this rung's own loop before any comparison is made and is never cited as authority.
assumptions.not_established: That the sibling receipt is itself correct.

assumptions.clause: Availability is recorded twice: at every node reached, within a bound of two items, independently of the item count at which the minimum was found; and at every state where a three-item enumeration is performed, within a bound of three items. Each census carries the count of nodes it visited and the count of candidates it examined, so a zero is a counted zero.
assumptions.not_established: Availability at a node whose run retained no minimum to price it against; those rows are counted apart and are outside the priced-out population. The census SPACE is this rung's own declaration at every item count, not the sealed generator: the frozen deferral clause governs the candidate space of the selection, and the datum-bearing construction builds directly from the declared universe at one and two items as well as at three. It is certified equal, as a set, to the deferring generator's datum-bearing subset at costs one to three on every base of the declared cross-check family, and nowhere else.

assumptions.clause: Scoring is a function of this receipt's own body and reads nothing else. A prediction whose population turns out empty is scored VACUOUS and is evidence of nothing; the verdict is never rounded up. The extrapolation is scored PENDING because it speaks of a rectangle this rung does not compute.
assumptions.not_established: That a HIT is evidence for the mechanism a prediction offers beside it.

observed_maxima.scope: the enumeration and class budgets govern the tree loop alone; the candidate and response budgets are enforced in the tree loop and in the situation gatherer, with the same terminals

by_declared_member.finding: the declared member is strictly stronger as a predicate and was exhibited refusing a delta the inherited member accepts; over the situations at which both were run here it returned the same valid set at every one

R1-4.scope_of_the_population: the headline is stated over every retained minimum of the rectangle; most were selected at one or two items, and the count selected at three items -- the space this rung declares -- is reported beside it so the three-item evidence is not read as the whole population

R1-5.mechanism_scope: the verdict is about three-item responses at the enumeration situations. The mechanism offered beside the frozen claim -- that an addition falling identically on both members of a pair cannot honour a same demand -- does NOT hold generally: at the two-item bound this run records same-kind rows at which a valid response carrying a fresh datum exists, and the by-kind split above is that count. A13 already declines to read a HIT as evidence for a mechanism; this is the specific disconfirming count, recorded rather than left to be recomputed

declared_member_totals.finding: the declared member is strictly stronger as a predicate and was exhibited refusing a delta the inherited member accepts; over the situations at which both were run here it returned the same valid set at every one

R1-6.mechanism_scope: the shape claim is scored over VALID THREE-ITEM responses at the enumeration situations. It is not a claim about every valid response to a same demand at every bound: at two items this run records valid same-kind responses carrying one instance, no rule and a fresh datum

R1-X.scored_by: the rung that reaches an item bound of four

by_declared_member.finding: the declared member is strictly stronger as a predicate and was exhibited refusing a delta the inherited member accepts; over the situations at which both were run here it returned the same valid set at every one

serialization.scope: the body is every key of this receipt but the scoring and this block, before the split; a second invocation writes the same bytes when the declared wall bound did not fire

the twenty runs of the two-item reconstruction
the re-derivation of the refusal population
